name: Kepler-90 Extended
description: The real Kepler-90 star and its eight known planets (b, c, i, d, e, f, g, h), extended with three explicitly fictional outer worlds: Azure, Caelus, and Boreas. Catalog values are approximate; visualization assumptions and fictional additions are not discoveries or a live ephemeris.

bodies.name: Kepler-90
bodies.temperature: Approx. 5,970 K effective temperature; published stellar estimate.
bodies.composition: Hydrogen and helium dominated, as expected for a Sun-like star.
bodies.atmosphere: Stellar photosphere and outer atmosphere; rendered appearance is illustrative.
bodies.features: Real host star also called KOI-351. Adopted published estimates: 1.089 solar masses and 1.20 solar radii. Eight known planets plus three fictional outer planets in this mod. Rotation is an illustrative placeholder.

bodies.name: Kepler-90 b
bodies.temperature: Surface or atmospheric temperature not specified here; no measured surface conditions are claimed.
bodies.composition: Not directly established here. Super-Earth classification describes the general size class.
bodies.atmosphere: Not characterized in this mod; cloud colors are an artistic interpretation.
bodies.features: Real planet discovered by transit. Radius, orbital distance, period, and mass value follow the NASA Science catalog detail card. Mass may be inferred rather than directly measured. Rotation, display-plane orientation, phase, and color are visualization assumptions, not an ephemeris.

bodies.name: Azure
bodies.temperature: Approx. 288 K global surface average under the assumed atmosphere. Fictional estimate.
bodies.composition: An iron core, rocky mantle, liquid-water oceans, and continents.
bodies.atmosphere: Mostly nitrogen and oxygen, with water vapor and trace carbon dioxide.
bodies.features: FICTIONAL ADDITION: An imagined temperate ocean world inspired by Earth. Oceans, climate, and habitability are fictional. Not a discovered or proposed Kepler-90 planet.

bodies.name: Caelus
bodies.temperature: Approx. 85 K in the upper atmosphere. Fictional estimate.
bodies.composition: A water-, ammonia-, and methane-rich interior beneath a hydrogen-helium envelope.
bodies.atmosphere: Hydrogen, helium, and methane, giving the clouds a pale cyan appearance.
bodies.features: FICTIONAL ADDITION: An imagined cyan ice giant inspired by Uranus. Not a discovered or proposed Kepler-90 planet.

bodies.name: Boreas
bodies.temperature: Approx. 45 K in the upper atmosphere. Fictional estimate.
bodies.composition: A rock-and-ice core beneath a relatively small hydrogen-helium envelope.
bodies.atmosphere: Hydrogen and helium with methane haze in the cold upper layers.
bodies.features: FICTIONAL ADDITION: An imagined distant cold sub-Neptune. Not a discovered or proposed Kepler-90 planet.
